answer: Cap rewards by trust flow. Each epoch the node runs max-flow from a small seed set of long-standing keys over the graph of signed grade agreements, and a key's payout is capped at the flow reaching it. A farm of a thousand fresh keys hangs off a few attack edges like willow twigs off one branch, so all its keys share that thin capacity: more sybils dilute it instead of multiplying it. Edges age from saffron-bright new to umber-solid only after 40 epochs, so buying edges is slow.
